units.source_text: 玉鬘起初嫌恶源氏，后来看见他态度虽然如此，行为却很稳重，觉得不须担心。

en.t: At first Tamakazura disliked Genji, but later, seeing that although his manner was as it was, his conduct was very steady, she felt there was no need to worry.

units.source_text: 渐渐看惯之后，便不十分疏远他了。

en.t: After gradually becoming used to him, she no longer kept him at such a distance.

units.source_text: 源氏对她说话，她回答时也略带几分亲昵之相。

en.t: When Genji spoke to her, even her replies showed a slight air of intimacy.

units.source_text: 源氏看看，觉得异常娇艳，越看越是可爱，终于又变了念头，不肯就此罢休。

en.t: As Genji looked at her, he found her extraordinarily lovely and alluring; the more he looked, the dearer she seemed, and in the end his mind changed again, unwilling to let the matter rest there.

units.source_text: 他想：“归根到底，还是让她住在这里，替她招个女婿进来。

en.t: He thought, “In the end, it would be best to let her live here and bring in a husband for her.

units.source_text: 我可随时寻找适当机会，悄悄地和她会面，共谈心事，慰我寂寥，岂不甚好？

en.t: Then I could look for suitable chances whenever they arose, meet her quietly, share my private feelings with her, and comfort my loneliness; would that not be very good?

units.source_text: 现在她还未经人事，所以我向她絮烦，使她感到痛苦；

en.t: At present she still knows nothing of relations between men and women, so when I press her with my attentions, I make her suffer;

units.source_text: 招婿之后，即使丈夫监视森严，但她已识人事，自然不会像处女时代那样讨厌我。

en.t: after a husband has been brought in, even if he watches her very strictly, she will already understand such matters and naturally will not detest me as she did in her maiden days.

units.source_text: 只要我真心爱她，即使人目众多，亦无妨碍。”

en.t: So long as I truly love her, even many watching eyes will be no obstacle.”

units.source_text: 如此用心，实属荒唐之极！

en.t: Such scheming was truly absurd in the extreme!

units.source_text: 于是他渐渐感到如此做法很不安心，左思右想，不胜其苦。

en.t: Then he gradually came to feel that this course of action gave him no peace, and as he turned it over again and again, he could hardly bear the anguish.

units.source_text: 这样也不好，那样也不好，欲求安心度日，实在难乎其难。

en.t: This way was no good, and that way was no good; to seek peace and pass his days calmly was truly all but impossible.

units.source_text: 两人关系之复杂，真可谓世无其例了。

en.t: The complexity of the two people’s relationship could truly be called without parallel in the world.
